title: dedicated-autoscaler-priority-burst-util-reporting-enhancement
author: Ava Chen
description: Motivation: several customers reported unexpected request queueing during short sustained bursts despite token-bucket limits. This PR improves Dedicated autoscaler behavior by adding priority-aware burst smoothing, enhancing throughput guarantees, and exposing richer utilization reporting for fleet operators. Changes are focused on three areas: 1) Priority-aware tokenbucket smoothing: the autoscaler now maintains per-priority smoothing state so high-priority workloads get more stable burst headroom while lower priorities are throttled earlier. This reduces oscillation when multiple customers increase load simultaneously. 2) Throughput guarantee adjustments: implement a new configurable throughput_floor per-pool that preserves a minimum committed serving throughput during scale-down windows, preventing transient underprovisioning for latency-sensitive routes. 3) Utilization and burst reporting: extend the metrics emitted by the fleet autoscaler to include per-pool sustained_utilization, burst_burn_rate, headroom_by_priority and policy_decision_trace identifiers so console dashboards can show historical burst consumption and the autoscaler's decision path. The implementation includes internal refactors to the autoscaler state machine to keep smoothing logic isolated and make policy evaluation deterministic. Backward compatibility: configuration defaults follow existing behavior; new fields are opt-in and gated by feature flags for dedicated customers. Testing: unit tests for token-bucket smoothing and priority demotion paths, end-to-end simulation tests against the autoscaler test harness using synthetic traces, and updated integration tests for metrics emission. Rollout plan: feature is behind a feature-flag that defaults off; staged rollout to Dedicated fleets via canary followed by 25/50/100% rollout after 48h stability window. Related: addresses ENG-1423 and partially addresses ENG-1581. This PR also contains minor docs additions for the console metric names and a migration note for customers using custom autoscaler policies.

Ava Chen: Good point, implemented epoch updates and added a benchmark in the test harness to show <3% CPU regression.

Ava Chen: Added tags and updated dashboard panels.

release_notes: Enhancement: priority-aware burst smoothing and throughput floor for Dedicated autoscaler; new utilization and burst reporting metrics (burst_burn_rate, headroom_by_priority, sustained_utilization). Config opt-in behind feature flag.
